name: Molty
tagline: Molty knows where the gold is buried
description: Molty is a hard-working mole digging under Solana while you sleep. $MOLTY — a community memecoin.

hero.text: While the whole town sleeps, Molty digs. Shift after shift, deeper than your bags.

about.title: A miner, not a moon boy
text: Molty lives deep under the Solana blockchain. He can barely see, but he can smell gold through three layers of rock.
No charts, no panic, no FUD. Just a helmet, a headlamp and a pickaxe. Every night he goes down for another shift.

howToBuy.title: Get a wallet
howToBuy.text: Install Phantom or Solflare from the official website or app store.

howToBuy.title: Get some SOL
howToBuy.text: Buy SOL on an exchange and send it to your wallet.

howToBuy.title: Open pump.fun
howToBuy.text: Connect your wallet and paste the $MOLTY contract address.

howToBuy.title: Swap for $MOLTY
howToBuy.text: Choose the amount, confirm the swap and join the shift.
